oneLineVerdict: BM-001 generated workspace is protected by BM_PANEL_BY_CODE, but runtime /templates/:code is generic ContractV2Renderer plus optional runtime-ux; PR-A must make profile readiness an explicit selector contract so audit-only/skeleton profiles cannot become authoritative.

scopeInspected.e2e: Static search only; no E2E executed.

topFindings.finding: Form Flight skeleton/audit-only profiles can be dangerous if any future selector reads getFormFlightProfile directly instead of isRuntimeReadyProfile.
topFindings.evidence: BM001_FORM_FLIGHT_PROFILE is registered, has field paths and required paths, but profileStatus='audit-only' and runtimeReady=false; tests pin helper no-op behavior.
topFindings.prARelevance: Main PR-A guard: selectors/adapters must deny non-runtime-ready profiles before they can affect UI/payload/gates.
topFindings.recommendation: Centralize profile selection behind isRuntimeReadyProfile and add route-level tests for BM-001/BM-171.

topFindings.finding: Runtime /templates/:code has no BM-specific selector; it always renders ContractV2Renderer plus optional runtime-ux.
topFindings.evidence: TemplatePreviewWorkspace loads getRuntimeFormContract and renders ContractV2Renderer; no BM_PANEL_BY_CODE branch exists there.
topFindings.prARelevance: Explains BM-001 perceived generic takeover on runtime route.
topFindings.recommendation: Add explicit runtime UI selector priority: existing-good runtime UI, runtime-ready profile, generic ContractV2Renderer fallback.

topFindings.finding: Generated workspace lets PublishedContractFormInputsPanel supersede BM_PANEL_BY_CODE when publishedRuntime is non-null.
topFindings.evidence: GeneratedDocumentWorkspace renders PublishedContractFormInputsPanel before Panel when publishedRuntime exists; Panel is BM_PANEL_BY_CODE[templateCode] ?? Generic.
topFindings.prARelevance: BM-specific UI can lose to published contract renderer in generated flow if runtime contract source changes.
topFindings.recommendation: Require generated-ready/published status before published contract UI can override an existing-good BM panel.

topFindings.finding: Many BM panels still use raw fetch or local readApi helpers rather than centralized api-client/document-form-api.
topFindings.evidence: Repo-wide search found raw fetch in many bm-XXX-form-inputs.tsx and local readApi in bm001/bm090/bm097/bm053/bm156 helper files.
topFindings.prARelevance: Test mocks and auth behavior can diverge across duplicate UI systems.
topFindings.recommendation: Defer migration; inventory only for PR-A, then migrate in later API/helper cleanup PR.

topFindings.finding: Generated/document stubs make registry coverage look more complete than true bespoke UI coverage.
topFindings.evidence: Many BM panels declare STUB and render GenericTemplateFormInputsPanel.
topFindings.prARelevance: Selector must distinguish existing-good UI from generic-wrapper panels.
topFindings.recommendation: Add metadata classification before allowing profile/generic fallback to supersede bespoke panels.

bm001Trace.runtimeRoute: /templates/BM-001 -> TemplatePreviewWorkspace -> getRuntimeFormContract -> getRuntimeUxProfile(null unless profile exists) -> ContractV2Renderer
bm001Trace.generatedRoute: /documents/:id where payload.template.templateCode='BM-001' -> GeneratedDocumentWorkspace -> BM_PANEL_BY_CODE['BM-001'] -> Bm001FormInputsPanel, unless publishedRuntime exists
bm001Trace.takeoverMechanism: The registered BM-001 Form Flight profile itself is currently no-op guarded; the visible runtime generic takeover comes from lack of runtime BM-specific selector. Future risk is any selector using getFormFlightProfile directly and treating audit-only BM-001 as authoritative.
bm001Trace.expectedPrAFix: Add selector tests and guard: audit-only/skeleton Form Flight profiles must never drive runtime UI/payload/summary; existing-good BM-001 UI remains winner where available.

bm171Trace.runtimeRoute: /templates/BM-171 -> TemplatePreviewWorkspace imports bm171 Form Flight profile -> runtime-ux BM171_PROFILE -> ContractV2Renderer with UX overrides -> preview-session/export helpers
bm171Trace.generatedRoute: /documents/:id BM-171 -> GeneratedDocumentWorkspace -> BM_PANEL_BY_CODE['BM-171'] -> Bm171FormInputsPanel -> Form Flight generated save/gate helpers -> saveDocumentFormInputs

currentLikelyWinner.runtime: ContractV2Renderer with BM-171 runtime-ux profile and Form Flight gate parity

bm171Trace.mustPreserve: runtime-ready Form Flight profile remains active; BM-171 required placeholder gate and demo parity continue working in both flows.
bm171Trace.expectedPrAGuardImpact: No regression because BM-171 has runtimeReady=true and profileStatus='runtime-ready'.

selectorFlowBefore: Runtime: route -> TemplatePreviewWorkspace -> ContractV2Renderer (+ runtime-ux if registered) -> /forms/runtime. Generated: route -> GeneratedDocumentWorkspace -> publishedRuntime ? PublishedContractFormInputsPanel : BM_PANEL_BY_CODE[templateCode] ?? GenericTemplateFormInputsPanel -> /documents/generated.
selectorFlowRisk: Runtime has no existing-good BM UI priority; generated has publishedRuntime override before BM-specific panel. Form Flight readiness guard exists but only protects helper consumers, not arbitrary future selectors.
recommendedSelectorFlowAfter: If lifecycle is generated-document and template has existing-good BM panel, prefer it unless an explicit generated-ready published contract override is true.
If lifecycle is runtime-template and template has existing-good runtime UI, prefer it.
If a Form Flight profile exists, use it only when isRuntimeReadyProfile(profile) is true.
If runtime-ux profile exists, use only as UI metadata for an already selected runtime-ready/generic renderer; do not imply profile readiness globally.
Fallback to ContractV2Renderer/GenericTemplateFormInputsPanel only when no protected existing-good UI applies.
testCoverageGapsForPrA: Route-level selector test for /templates/BM-001 proving BM001 audit-only profile cannot drive summary/gate/payload or replace existing-good UI decision.
Generated workspace selector test proving BM-001 BM_PANEL_BY_CODE wins over generic fallback and cannot be superseded by skeleton/audit-only profile.
BM-171 regression test proving runtime-ready profile still gates missing required fields and generated save helper still sanitizes stale fallbacks.
PublishedContractFormInputsPanel precedence test documenting when it may override BM_PANEL_BY_CODE.
Static guard test that all Form Flight selector consumers import isRuntimeReadyProfile rather than raw getFormFlightProfile for runtime authority.
